# Any scope. Live bound host exists and is not a rebel country.
oe_sea_has_live_host = {
    has_global_variable = oe_sea_host
    exists = global_var:oe_sea_host
    global_var:oe_sea_host = { is_rebel_country = no }
}

# Any scope. Zero-override read-only bridge to vanilla situation:fall_of_delhi.
oe_sea_fall_of_delhi_active = {
    situation:fall_of_delhi = { situation_is_active = yes }
}

# Any scope. Detects Deccan Muslim rival: c:BAH if formed, else Muslim ruler of gulbarga.
oe_sea_deccan_muslim_present = {
    OR = {
        AND = { country_exists = c:BAH c:BAH = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        location:gulbarga = {
            has_owner = yes
            owner = {
                is_rebel_country = no
                religion.group = religion_group:muslim
            }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. Detects Bengal regional power: c:BNG if formed, else 1337 SGN/GAU or sonargaon/gaur holder.
oe_sea_bengal_present = {
    OR = {
        AND = { country_exists = c:BNG c:BNG = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        AND = { country_exists = c:SGN c:SGN = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        AND = { country_exists = c:GAU c:GAU = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        location:sonargaon = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        location:gaur = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } }
    }
}

# Any scope. Read-only check: Roman Company active (country var oe_cmp_holder on BYZ or ROM; 0 WARN VAR).
oe_sea_roman_company_active = {
    OR = {
        AND = {
            country_exists = c:ROM
            c:ROM = {
                is_rebel_country = no
                has_variable = oe_cmp_holder
                trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_end } NOT = { var:oe_cmp_end = 3 } }
            }
        }
        AND = {
            country_exists = c:BYZ
            c:BYZ = {
                is_rebel_country = no
                has_variable = oe_cmp_holder
                trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_end } NOT = { var:oe_cmp_end = 3 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

    trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_red_canal_stage } global_var:oe_red_canal_stage >= 3 }
}

# Any scope. Read-only check: Timur/Central Asian horsemen deflected south by Iran (oe_irt_/IRA) or Yuan east defense (oe_ytm_).
oe_sea_timurid_deflected_south = {
    OR = {
        country_exists = c:IRA
        AND = {
            has_global_variable = oe_irt_safavid_path
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_irt_safavid_path } global_var:oe_irt_safavid_path >= 1 }
        }
        AND = {
            has_global_variable = oe_ytm_legacy
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ytm_legacy } global_var:oe_ytm_legacy >= 1 }
        }
        AND = {
            has_global_variable = oe_ytm_done
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ytm_done } global_var:oe_ytm_done >= 1 }
        }
        country_exists = c:TIM
    }
}

# Any scope. Node 1 (East): jinjiang open via Yuan Shibosi (oe_ymar_policy = 2) or peaceful high-stability port holder.
oe_sea_node_east_ready = {
    location:jinjiang = {
        has_owner = yes
        owner = { is_rebel_country = no }
    }
    OR = {
        oe_sea_yuan_shibosi_active = yes
        location:jinjiang = {
            has_owner = yes
            owner = {
                is_rebel_country = no
                at_war = no
                stability >= 15
            }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. Node 2 (Hub): malacca + kozhikode open via charters or peaceful post-1410 transit.
oe_sea_node_hub_ready = {
    location:malacca = {
        has_owner = yes
        owner = { is_rebel_country = no }
    }
    location:kozhikode = {
        has_owner = yes
        owner = { is_rebel_country = no }
    }
    OR = {
        AND = {
            has_global_variable = oe_sea_malabar_charter
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_malabar_charter } global_var:oe_sea_malabar_charter <= 2 }
        }
        AND = {
            has_global_variable = oe_sea_malacca_open
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_malacca_open } global_var:oe_sea_malacca_open >= 1 }
        }
        AND = {
            has_global_variable = oe_sea_java_open
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_java_open } global_var:oe_sea_java_open = 1 }
        }
        AND = {
            current_year >= 1410
            location:malacca = { has_owner = yes owner = { at_war = no } }
            location:kozhikode = { has_owner = yes owner = { at_war = no } }
        }
    }
}

}
